A source-bootstrap upper bound below -0.01 rejects the previous empty-only explanation; an interval spanning that margin leaves it unresolved. This is conditional checkpoint evidence, not a causal loss comparison.
proposals.evaluation_plan: Three frozen arms times one pairing seed; zero new training. The previous experiment completed execution, but its exposed summaries omit reviewable joint-stratum and ratio results. This follow-up explicitly completes that scientific evidence rather than claiming a new mechanism. Use only same-source synthetic controls and disjoint 18/36 normal partitions. Retain all negative results and missing historical traces. If conditional ranking fails, close Dice=0.25 and continue BCE research; if preserved, retain the narrow omission accounting result but still close Dice screening because logical AU-sPRO and AP already regressed. If unresolved, report unresolved and do not launch another narrower proxy. Existing real results remain LOCO custom-split development feedback — not official full-test results. Estimated frozen work is small relative to the remaining deadline; interruption leaves this completion INCOMPLETE.
proposals.priority_rationale: Closes the critic's specific unresolved falsification at approximately the prior 41-second diagnostic cost, without another 900-second training branch. The real Dice losses make branch closure more valuable than another proposed rescue.

proposals.claim: At calibration pixel FPR 0.001, Dice must reduce source-mean selected-to-footprint distance by at least 20% relative to BCE, without increasing footprint-to-selected distance by more than 0.01 image diagonals. Otherwise reject this bounded spatial-selectivity interpretation. This is conditional on frozen checkpoints and synthetic footprints.

proposals.claim: On identical native-grid queries, Dice-minus-BCE improvement from ranking logits instead of float32 sigmoid scores exceeds 0.01 with a positive 95% source-bootstrap lower bound, and the logit-ranked Dice-minus-BCE AP gap is at least -0.01. Otherwise reject this bounded numerical explanation of the observed deficit.
proposals.evaluation_plan: Three frozen arms at one pairing index; zero optimization. Use only within-source relocation controls and 36 independent source clusters. Bootstrap Dice-minus-BCE ranking_gain separately from logit AP difference. This directly falsifies a numerical alternative to a learned ranking deficit without another operating-point proxy. If supported, preregister a later trusted real-localization readout comparison; if rejected, close this numerical rescue and retain BCE/incumbent preference. Neither outcome repairs the missing jointly nonempty analysis or changes the previous COMPLETE_EXPLORATORY status. Request no new real feedback for unchanged deployed predictors. Future selection must prioritize logical AU-sPRO@5% and pixel AP, retaining their combined 80% weight. Estimated replay and analysis fit within the original remaining deadline; no 900-second new training can fit.
proposals.priority_rationale: Directly tests a materially different explanation for the measured -0.022347 Dice-minus-BCE AP gap, using cheap shared-logit reductions instead of expensive spatial distances or retraining. A negative result ends a concrete rescue route.
proposals.research_question: Does float32 sigmoid rounding disproportionately reduce Dice659 synthetic localization AP relative to BCE659?

proposals.claim: For Dice659, source-mean cosine between the good-control Dice head gradient and positive-query BCE head gradient is below -0.25, with a bootstrap upper bound below -0.25, and the source-mean ratio of their norms after applying the historical Dice coefficient 0.25 exceeds 0.1. Otherwise reject this bounded head-opposition mechanism.
proposals.evaluation_plan: Three frozen arms times one pairing index produces three jobs, with actual seeds explicitly pinned. This avoids starting a 900-second training loop that cannot fit the remaining campaign deadline. On 36 independent normal assessment sources, average four same-source relocation variants before source bootstrap. Good controls use the originating 0.95*x+0.025 recipe. Verify analytical derivatives against central finite differences on disposable head vectors without changing checkpoint tensors or enabling backward. Support would prioritize a later independently initialized BCE/all-image-Dice/positive-only-Dice training matrix with real logical AU-sPRO and pixel AP carrying 80% combined priority. Rejection retires this control-gradient explanation and retains BCE as the practical starting objective. These measurements describe local head geometry, not historical optimization trajectories or real LOCO localization. Existing trace and stream-integrity gaps remain unresolved; no missing traces are reconstructed. No continuing schedule is needed because all arms are frozen.
proposals.priority_rationale: Directly investigates the existing loss after numerical, threshold-only and empty-selection explanations failed. Analytical head gradients are inexpensive and executable under frozen inference, and distinguish a concrete future objective ablation from retiring Dice without another proxy-ranking screen.
